2435135.name: Chabad of Greater Downtown Detroit
2435135.note: Rabbi Yisrael Pinson named emissary for downtown Detroit in April 2013; the house at 278 Mack Ave opened with an open house on 16 Jan 2014 (Jewish News, Dec 2013 and Feb 2014). Before its building: the Jewish News, Jan 7 2016: 'It was the spring and summer of 2013 and Rabbi Yisrael Pinson worked out of Downtown coffee shops as he prepared to launch the Chabad of Greater Downtown Detroit at 278 Mack Ave.'; a Feb 2014 neighborhood get-together welcomed it as 'new neighbors', and its events were at 278 Mack by June 2014.

earlier.where: Downtown Detroit coffee shops, where Rabbi Yisrael Pinson worked while preparing the launch (spring and summer 2013)
